title: Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition
summary: Yann LeCun, Léon Bottou, Yoshua Bengio, and Patrick Haffner published 'Gradient-Based Learning Applied to Document Recognition' in the November 1998 issue of Proceedings of the IEEE. The paper reviews gradient-based methods for handwritten-character recognition, reports that convolutional neural networks outperform the other techniques compared on a standard handwritten-digit task, and describes graph transformer networks for globally trained multimodule document-recognition systems.
significance: A documented neural-network and document-recognition research milestone connecting convolutional neural-network methods, back-propagation-based learning, and globally trained document-recognition systems in a primary IEEE publication.
